requestCompletenessContext.identity: [1,"For Singapore corporate income tax, is incorporation in Singapore alone enough to make a company tax resident? Explain the general control-and-management test using IRAS guidance. Do not calculate tax or create journal entries. Separately, Under IRAS rules, can cash top-ups to my own CPF Special Account or Retirement Account qualify for tax relief? Explain the general eligibility conditions and relief limits using official IRAS guidance. This is a general rules question; do not calculate my personal tax or create journal entries. Separately, A Singapore GST-registered business purchases a private passenger motor car for business use. Is the GST on the purchase generally claimable as input tax? Explain the general IRAS restriction and relevant exceptions. Do not calculate amounts or create journal entries."]
